loc.start.name: Traveler's Road
loc.start.description: A dusty road leading into town. To the east stands the light of a wayside inn.

loc.inn_hall.name: Inn Hall
loc.inn_hall.description: A warm common room, tables scattered around a crackling hearth. The bartender wipes down the counter.

loc.inn_corridor.name: Inn Corridor
loc.inn_corridor.description: A narrow, creaking hallway lit by a single lantern.

loc.inn_room1.name: Guest Room
loc.inn_room1.description: A small rented room with a lumpy bed and a shuttered window.

loc.inn_room2.name: Guest Room
loc.inn_room2.description: Another rented room, this one smelling faintly of pipe smoke.

loc.inn_bathroom.name: Inn Bathroom
loc.inn_bathroom.description: A cramped bathroom shared by the inn's guests. The pipes groan constantly.

loc.basement.name: Inn Basement
loc.basement.description: A damp cellar stacked with old barrels. Something skitters in the dark corners.

loc.sewer_entrance.name: Sewer Entrance
loc.sewer_entrance.description: A narrow tunnel mouth where the inn's cellar gives way to the sewers below. The air reeks of mildew.

loc.sewer_corridor_1.name: Sewer Passage
loc.sewer_corridor_1.description: A low, dripping passage. Rat droppings crunch underfoot.

loc.sewer_chamber_1.name: Flooded Chamber
loc.sewer_chamber_1.description: A wider chamber where the sewer walls have crumbled, exposing bare earth.

loc.sewer_chamber_2.name: Stagnant Pool
loc.sewer_chamber_2.description: Stagnant water pools in the middle of this chamber, rippling with unseen movement.

loc.sewer_nest.name: Rat Nest
loc.sewer_nest.description: A nest of gnawed bones and shredded cloth fills this dead-end alcove. Something bigger lives here.

loc.sewer_corridor_2.name: Curving Passage
loc.sewer_corridor_2.description: A long, curving passage that loops back toward the entrance tunnel.

npc.bartender.name: Bartender
npc.bartender.description: A burly bartender, sleeves rolled up, keeping a watchful eye on the room.
dialogue: Welcome, traveler. Rooms are upstairs, drinks are on the house tonight.
Something's been nesting in my basement. Rats, big ones - would you deal with them?

npc.rat_1.name: Sewer Rat
npc.rat_1.description: A mangy rat, bigger than it has any right to be.
